ladder.title: Price ladder by category

promo.title: Promotion depth

brands.title: Brand price positioning
brands.question: Median price of the {n} brands with the most products.
brands.label: Median price per brand, {n} brands, highest first.

mix.title: Category mix
mix.question: Products per category; area is the count.

hist.title: Price distribution

top.title: Top discounts

share.question: How much of the catalogue the largest brands hold.
